authority.purpose: Single machine-readable authority for current project/strategy/control-plane state.
precedence: Live runtime evidence in Supabase/MINI-PC is authoritative for instantaneous health/evidence counts.

This file is authoritative for declared strategy/research freeze and shadow lineage; technical live series may rotate independently; the last-verified operational-series snapshot below is dated and never supersedes real-time Supabase/MINI-PC.
docs/master-version-register.md is authoritative for version/history/component records.
PROJECT_BACKLOG.md is authoritative only for open work, never for current runtime status.
Research/framework documents define methodology and may retain dated historical text.
authority.transition_rule: Every material activation, closure, rollback, promotion, baseline switch or strategy-changing shadow start/stop must update this file in the same bounded release/change sequence.

technical_rotation_runtime_last_verified.source: Supabase public.paper_series joined with public.paper_technical_rotations plus minipc_status_current, read-only prior audit

queued.rule: Do not activate as a second strategy-changing shadow while H3 is running.

next_control_decisions.action: Perform fixed review; classify keep/reject/inconclusive. Do not auto-extend or tune.

next_control_decisions.trigger: Preregistered V2R4 evidence/productivity gate or clear low-trade pathology review point
next_control_decisions.action: Assess candidate-to-trade production and root causes using the full funnel, WAIT->REJECT/TTL-expiry rates, mature MFE/MAE/missed-move evidence, and input-data freshness/completeness. Low trade frequency is evidence, not justification for indefinite extension or silent tuning.

v2r4_productivity_watch.interpretation: Trade production is a mandatory review criterion. Current zero-buy conversion and high WAIT-to-REJECT rate are early warning evidence only; do not tune the frozen series before mature follow-up evidence distinguishes correct rejection from restrictive triggers or missing context.
future_review_requirements: Compare later MFE/MAE and missed-move rates for REJECT and WAIT->REJECT cases.
Separate true setup invalidity from WAIT/TTL strictness, data/context insufficiency, cost hurdle, and scanner/discovery timing.
Check freshness/completeness of OHLC, ATR/structural-stop, volume and execution-cost context.
Carry any validated finding into the next version/migration ledger; never silently retune the active frozen series.
v2r4_productivity_watch.successor_carry_forward: Applies to V2R4 review, V3/V4+ inheritance and later live-learning successor reviews.
